name: interactive-hover-button
title: Interactive Hover Button
blurb: Text slides left and new text slides in on hover.
description: A button that animates outgoing text left while new text slides in from the right on hover.
use_when: You need a playful hover interaction that reveals different text.
avoid_when: On touch-only devices where hover is unreliable.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Text swap is visual. No aria-label describing the swap state.
